.47. From the above discussion, it is seen that PW.1 has produced sale deeds in-respect of small plot of land measuring 2400 sq. feet and 666 sq. feet.

.49.
.50. The land acquired in the present case is situated outside BBMP limits at the time of acquisition.
The land in Ex.P.31 has been acquired under preliminary L.A.C. No.288/1999 notification dated 29.07.1978, the land in the present case has been acquired under preliminary notification dated 21.09.1978.
Both notifications are during the same time.

The reference Court has enhanced the market value to Rs. 64,750/- per acre.
Hence, I am of the view that market value of the land acquired in the present case has to be fixed at Rs. 64,750/- per acre.

inadequate and on lower side.
